blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After claiming that lawyer Manases Carpio’s property matched the item declared by Vice President Sara Duterte, the Davao City land assessor was questioned how he was able to make that connection when Duterte’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) did not contain details. Counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. raised this question on Monday, at the resumption of Duterte’s impeachment trial, after Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin claimed that the Carpio’s 379-square-meter parcel of land in Davao City’s Matina Crossing is the same as the property declared by his wif, particularly the residential lot in […]...
